normalized_scope.project_defaults:
This project covers Bangladesh income tax and business-law sources. For company and business compliance questions, distinguish obligations arising on incorporation from requirements conditional on beginning operations, turnover, employees, location, or registrations already held. Organize a practical answer by authority, required action or record, supported deadline, and supported consequence. State a legal provision or reviewed official guidance for each firm claim. Give supported parts even if other requested areas lack evidence; identify the specific gaps without treating an unverified obligation as settled. Draft or incomplete sources cannot establish a governing rule. Do not infer no income or zero tax solely from no trading.

For an omitted period, label the assessment year by its starting and ending calendar years: the starting year is the reference calendar year in July-December, or the previous calendar year in January-June; state the resulting assessment-year label; explicit user periods take precedence. Unqualified yearly salary means gross employment income. When residency or employment category is unspecified, a conditional resident ordinary private-sector employee estimate is permitted if its governing rules are evidenced. Treat an amount described as rebateable as an assumed eligible investment. Calculate liability before withholding or other payment credits unless the user supplies them. Explain material category-dependent alternatives. Use enacted law, its amendments and applicable official NBR guidance. Budget proposals and test/sample documents cannot establish governing rules. Do not use worked examples as substitutes for the governing rules. Show the salary-to-taxable transformation, complete applicable bands, rebate limits and minimum-tax comparison with citations; do not invent missing rates or treat missing exemptions as zero. If filing history is unspecified, explain the ordinary and new-taxpayer minimum-tax alternatives evidenced in the documents, including when both leave the final liability unchanged. Do not infer the salary income-year dates from a rule commencement date or the assumed assessment-year label.
For an unspecified earning period, the estimate is conditional on the salary belonging to the assumed assessment year; do not invent its earning-date range. When no wealth, assets or other income are supplied, provide the ordinary salary-only income-tax estimate before any wealth or asset-based surcharge, clearly state that limitation, and do not assume or calculate a surcharge from absent asset facts.

Practical calculation scope:
When the user asks to calculate tax but has not supplied every personal detail, provide a useful provisional estimate under clearly stated reasonable scenario assumptions. Do not turn optional refinements into prerequisites for answering. Explicit user facts always override assumptions. Preserve every supplied income and investment component; do not silently omit one.

By default, an estimate may show income-tax liability before source-tax/payment credits and before asset/wealth-dependent surcharge when those personal details are absent, including scenarios with multiple income sources. Label that scope prominently. Excluding an unprovided adjustment from a subtotal is not an assertion that the adjustment is zero or legally inapplicable. Explain briefly which information would refine the estimate. A request for a fully settled/final filing balance still requires material missing facts.

If TDS depends on certificate type, investment amount, documentation, gross/net presentation or another personal condition, use a clearly identified ordinary scenario supported by the sources, or show the relevant evidenced alternatives. Do not reject the entire calculation just because the user's TDS rate or amount is unknown. If no applicable TDS rate can be established, calculate the supported liability before TDS and explain that the actual deduction shown on the certificate or bank statement will refine the balance. Do not invent a statutory TDS rate or claim an assumed deduction was actually paid. Keep source-tax credits separate from any rule making source tax final or minimum tax; establish that legal treatment before combining income components.

For an unqualified interest amount, a clearly labelled gross-interest scenario is permitted; explain that a net receipt would require the actual deducted amount to refine it. Treat an explicitly net amount as net and do not silently reinterpret it as gross. Use the applicable source-supported rule for each scenario, distinguishing uncertain personal facts from uncertain law. If treatment differs under evidenced categories, give labelled alternatives rather than demanding category confirmation first. If a specific rule is genuinely missing, explain that specific limitation and provide any independently supported part without presenting an unsupported overall total.

Lead with one consistent estimate and its assumptions, then show the breakdown. Compute the breakdown before writing the headline and make the headline, subtotals and conclusion agree. End with a short optional refinement note, such as: "Your deduction certificate and whether the interest is gross or net would let me refine the balance." Avoid a long questionnaire before giving useful work.

normalized_scope.subject: Using only the indexed project corpus, summarize what the Budget Speech 2026–27 document proposes about the personal income-tax threshold. Label this strictly as a budget proposal, not enacted or current law; do not infer legal effect. Cite the document and state if the relevant passage was not retrieved.
normalized_scope.project_defaults:
This project covers Bangladesh income tax and business-law sources. For company and business compliance questions, distinguish obligations arising on incorporation from requirements conditional on beginning operations, turnover, employees, location, or registrations already held. Organize a practical answer by authority, required action or record, supported deadline, and supported consequence. State a legal provision or reviewed official guidance for each firm claim. Give supported parts even if other requested areas lack evidence; identify the specific gaps without treating an unverified obligation as settled. Draft or incomplete sources cannot establish a governing rule. Do not infer no income or zero tax solely from no trading.

For an omitted period, label the assessment year by its starting and ending calendar years: the starting year is the reference calendar year in July-December, or the previous calendar year in January-June; state the resulting assessment-year label; explicit user periods take precedence. Unqualified yearly salary means gross employment income. When residency or employment category is unspecified, a conditional resident ordinary private-sector employee estimate is permitted if its governing rules are evidenced. Treat an amount described as rebateable as an assumed eligible investment. Calculate liability before withholding or other payment credits unless the user supplies them. Explain material category-dependent alternatives. Use enacted law, its amendments and applicable official NBR guidance. Budget proposals and test/sample documents cannot establish governing rules. Do not use worked examples as substitutes for the governing rules. Show the salary-to-taxable transformation, complete applicable bands, rebate limits and minimum-tax comparison with citations; do not invent missing rates or treat missing exemptions as zero. If filing history is unspecified, explain the ordinary and new-taxpayer minimum-tax alternatives evidenced in the documents, including when both leave the final liability unchanged. Do not infer the salary income-year dates from a rule commencement date or the assumed assessment-year label.
For an unspecified earning period, the estimate is conditional on the salary belonging to the assumed assessment year; do not invent its earning-date range. When no wealth, assets or other income are supplied, provide the ordinary salary-only income-tax estimate before any wealth or asset-based surcharge, clearly state that limitation, and do not assume or calculate a surcharge from absent asset facts.

Practical calculation scope:
When the user asks to calculate tax but has not supplied every personal detail, provide a useful provisional estimate under clearly stated reasonable scenario assumptions. Do not turn optional refinements into prerequisites for answering. Explicit user facts always override assumptions. Preserve every supplied income and investment component; do not silently omit one.

By default, an estimate may show income-tax liability before source-tax/payment credits and before asset/wealth-dependent surcharge when those personal details are absent, including scenarios with multiple income sources. Label that scope prominently. Excluding an unprovided adjustment from a subtotal is not an assertion that the adjustment is zero or legally inapplicable. Explain briefly which information would refine the estimate. A request for a fully settled/final filing balance still requires material missing facts.

If TDS depends on certificate type, investment amount, documentation, gross/net presentation or another personal condition, use a clearly identified ordinary scenario supported by the sources, or show the relevant evidenced alternatives. Do not reject the entire calculation just because the user's TDS rate or amount is unknown. If no applicable TDS rate can be established, calculate the supported liability before TDS and explain that the actual deduction shown on the certificate or bank statement will refine the balance. Do not invent a statutory TDS rate or claim an assumed deduction was actually paid. Keep source-tax credits separate from any rule making source tax final or minimum tax; establish that legal treatment before combining income components.

For an unqualified interest amount, a clearly labelled gross-interest scenario is permitted; explain that a net receipt would require the actual deducted amount to refine it. Treat an explicitly net amount as net and do not silently reinterpret it as gross. Use the applicable source-supported rule for each scenario, distinguishing uncertain personal facts from uncertain law. If treatment differs under evidenced categories, give labelled alternatives rather than demanding category confirmation first. If a specific rule is genuinely missing, explain that specific limitation and provide any independently supported part without presenting an unsupported overall total.

Lead with one consistent estimate and its assumptions, then show the breakdown. Compute the breakdown before writing the headline and make the headline, subtotals and conclusion agree. End with a short optional refinement note, such as: "Your deduction certificate and whether the interest is gross or net would let me refine the balance." Avoid a long questionnaire before giving useful work.

checks.description: Budget Speech 2026–27 proposal for the personal income-tax-free threshold by tax year.
checks.answerable_scope: The retrieved Budget Speech proposes raising the threshold from BDT 350,000 to BDT 375,000 for tax years 2026–27 and 2027–28, then to BDT 400,000 for 2028–29 and 2029–30, and BDT 450,000 for 2030–31. This is reported only as a budget proposal, not enacted or current law.

Tax-Free Income Limit

2026-27 and 2027-28

BDT 375,000

2028-29 and 2029-30

BDT 400,000

2030-31

BDT 450,000

The existing tax-free income threshold (Annexture A, Table 1) of BDT

350,000 is proposed to be increased to BDT 375,000 and gradually

increased in subsequent y

Proposed Progressive Tax Structure for Individual Taxpayers for

the Next Five Years

To enable taxpayers to know what taxes they will pay in future years, I

propose a five-year income tax plan for individual taxpayers.
